records.title: Timeouts begin after deploy
records.content: 14:03-14:18 UTC checkout-api emits 431 payment_authorization_timeout errors for eu-west card checkout. The same error appears 7 times in the previous hour.

records.title: Error path includes payment provider call
records.content: Stack traces show the timeout occurs while waiting for PaymentProvider.authorize, after the checkout service changed the provider request deadline.

records.title: No matching inventory or fraud errors
records.content: The same time window has no increase in inventory_reservation_failed, fraud_declined, or address_validation_failed errors.

records.title: Deployment marker
records.content: Checkout service deployment checkout-api@2026.06.16.1400 completed at 14:01 UTC and changed PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_TIMEOUT_MS from 1500 to 800.
